events.title: The former 사우샘프턴 and Republic of Ireland winger Austin Hayes dies of lung cancer at the age of 28, three weeks after the illness was diagnosed. He had recently returned from a short spell playing in Sweden, and since leaving 사우샘프턴 in 1981 had also played for 밀월 and 노샘프턴 타운 .

The top three clubs in the First Division – 아스널, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 에버턴 – all record victories. 리버풀's hopes of retaining the title are hit by a 2–0 defeat at 왓퍼드. The pressure mounts on 첼시 manager John Hollins after watching his side lose 4–0 at home to 윔블던.
A six-goal thriller at Old Trafford sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 draw 3–3.
리버풀 play 셀틱 in an unofficial 'British Championship' match in the United Arab Emirates . After the match finished 1–1 after 90 minutes, 리버풀 win 4–2 on penalties to win the first Dubai Super Cup .

애스턴 빌라 come from 3–1 down in the final minutes to draw 3–3 with 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a First Division clash at Villa Park . Leaders 아스널 draw 1–1 with 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . 에버턴's title hopes are hit by a 1–0 away defeat to 루턴 타운, who climb into fourth place. 맨체스터 시티's survival hopes are given a boost with a 3–1 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드.
Argentina's 리버 플레이트 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 by defeating Romania's Steaua București 1–0. The only goal is scored by Antonio Alzamendi in the 28th minute.

18 months after the stadium fire that killed 56 spectators, 브래드퍼드 시티 return to a revamped Valley Parade . In the First Division, 레스터 시티 climb out of the bottom four with a 2–0 home win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. 첼시 are now bottom after losing 3–0 at 리버풀.

아스널 go five points clear at the top with a 3–0 home win over 루턴 타운. 맨체스터 유나이티드's revival continues with a 2–0 home win over 레스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트's drop two points in a goalless draw at home to 사우샘프턴. 포츠머스 go top of the Second Division by beating 반즐리 2–1 at home, although OldhamA thletic are two points behind them with two games in hand.

토트넘 홋스퍼 sell defender Graham Roberts to 레인저스 for £450,000. 올덤 애슬레틱 return to the top of the Second Division with a 2–1 home win over 브래드퍼드 시티. Promotion contenders 리즈 유나이티드 suffer a 7–2 defeat to 스토크 시티 at the Victoria Ground . 더비 카운티 go third and boost their hopes of a second successive promotion by beating 그림즈비 타운 4–0 at the Baseball Ground .
Graeme Souness continues to buy English-based players for 레인저스 by making a £120,000 move for 동커스터 로버스 striker Neil Woods .
토트넘 홋스퍼 sign midfielder Steve Hodge from 애스턴 빌라 for £650,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 리버풀 1–0 at Anfield. It is United's first away win of the season. Leaders 아스널 drop points in a 1–1 draw at 레스터 시티, but 노팅엄 포리스트 fail to take advantage as they lose 2–1 at 노리치 시티. 에버턴 win 4–0 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 토트넘 홋스퍼 climb into fifth place with a 4–0 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. In the Second Division, 브래드퍼드 시티's first game back at Valley Parade ends in a 1–0 home defeat to 더비 카운티. 포츠머스 return to the top of the Second Division with a 3–2 win over 플리머스 아가일 at Home Park , as 올덤 애슬레틱 surrender their lead of the table after being held to a 2–2 draw by 그림즈비 타운 at Blundell Park .

노리치 시티 win 1–0 away to 맨체스터 유나이티드. 아스널 remain in pole position with a 1–0 home win over 사우샘프턴. 토트넘 홋스퍼's erratic league form continues as they lose 4–3 at 코번트리 시티. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 fall into the bottom half of the table with a 3–2 home defeat to 윔블던. 첼시 halt their dismal form with a 4–1 home win over 애스턴 빌라. In the Second Division, 스토크 시티 keep up the pressure on the pace-setters with a 5–2 win over 셰필드 유나이티드. A relegation crunch game sees 허더즈필드 타운 beat 브래드퍼드 시티 by the same scoreline at Leeds Road. 더비 카운티 go top of the table with a 3–2 home win over 반즐리.

찰턴 애슬레틱 climb off the top of the First Division and jump up five places to 17th with a 5–0 home win over 맨체스터 시티. 에버턴 cut 아스널's lead at the top to four points by beating 레스터 시티 5–1 at Goodison Park. 노팅엄 포리스트 drop more points in the title race with a 2–2 draw at home to 루턴 타운.

The year draws to a close with 아스널 leading the league by four points from 에버턴. 레스터 시티 are bottom of the table, but are within three points of six other teams. The race for First Division football next season is headed by 포츠머스, while 더비 카운티 have moved into second.
